name: Freiberg Disease
definition: Osteonecrosis and collapse of a metatarsal head, most commonly the second, causing forefoot pain in adolescents or young adults.

investigations.principle: Radiographs show flattening/sclerosis in established disease; MRI detects early changes.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Advanced collapse may require surgical debridement/osteotomy or reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada Asthi-Sandhi phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Osteonecrosis and collapse of a metatarsal head, most commonly the second, causing forefoot pain in adolescents or young adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
